name: hcs-web-starter
description: Copy-paste Hedera Consensus Service helpers for web apps: HashPack wallet, topics, messages, HIP-991 fees, mirror reads, NFTs.

steps.text: Paste NEXT_PUBLIC_WALLETCONNECT_PROJECT_ID from https://cloud.reown.com into packages/nextjs/.env.local. Leave NEXT_PUBLIC_HEDERA_NETWORK=testnet.
Open HashPack on Hedera testnet. Generate keys → Connect → Create topic → Send → Get messages. Steal lib/hedera.js and lib/wallet.js, not Playground.jsx.
